capabilities.name: Versioned policy bundle schema
capabilities.description: A JSON Schema defines policy identity, default effect, rule effects, principals, actions, resources, and required scopes.
limitations: Schema structure does not establish policy authenticity or suitability.

capabilities.name: Decision request schema
capabilities.description: A JSON Schema defines principal, action, resource, scopes, and constrained context fields.
limitations: The schema does not authenticate the principal or authorize the request.

capabilities.name: Deterministic default-deny evaluator
capabilities.description: A local evaluator validates input and applies explicit-deny-overrides and default-deny semantics.
limitations: No identity authentication, remote policy distribution, resource-boundary enforcement, or production security guarantee.

capabilities.name: Authenticated signed policy distribution
capabilities.description: Distribute and verify policy bundles against configured trust roots and freshness rules.
limitations: No signed policy distribution or cryptographic verification is implemented.

capabilities.name: Protected resource enforcement adapters
capabilities.description: Integrate policy decisions with protected resource boundaries and fail-closed enforcement.
limitations: No protected resource adapter or enforcement middleware is implemented.

explicit_non_capabilities: Cryptographic signing or verification of policy bundles
Remote policy distribution or policy management service
